flagged.sentence: 当天按什么顺序宣读，材料没有记。
the order in which they were read that day is not recorded.

Wallace's essay, with its dateline and the manner of its sending, was consistent with Lyell and Hooker's statement that the two men had worked unknown to one another, and it was Wallace himself who had sent the essay to Darwin, with the express wish that Darwin forward it to Lyell if he thought it sufficiently novel and interesting.
the part about Darwin stating his own priority later, like the other two options, was constructed by the author for contrast and is not recorded in the documents.
同样，证据包没有说明华莱士在宣读之前是否知情、是否同意，这一点本文不作任何陈述。
Likewise, the evidence does not say whether Wallace knew of the reading beforehand or consented to it, and this article makes no statement either way.
The price is that it leaves no record of who did what.
华莱士在宣读前是否知情或同意，材料未载，本文不作陈述；
whether Wallace knew of or consented to the reading beforehand is not recorded in the material and no statement is made;

W2-LINN.title: Darwin and Wallace, 'On the Tendency of Species to form Varieties…', Journal of the Proceedings of the Linnean Society (1858), with the covering letter of Lyell and Hooker, Wikisource
W2-LINN.ref: en:On the tendency of species to form varieties; and on the Perpetuation of Varieties and Species by Natural Means of Selection

W2-PSM.title: 'Sketch of Alfred Russel Wallace', Popular Science Monthly, vol. 11 (June 1877), Wikisource
W2-PSM.ref: en:Popular Science Monthly/Volume 11/June 1877/Sketch of Alfred Russel Wallace

episode.outcome: Lyell and Hooker's letter ends with Darwin's consent and their stated reason: the leading results of both men are to be laid before the public together. The heading records that the papers were read on 1 July 1858, and the printed record closes with Wallace's essay and its dateline.
episode.quote: On representing this to Mr. Darwin, he gave us permission to make what use we thought proper of his memoir, &c.; and in adopting our present course, of presenting it to the Linnean Society, we have explained to him that we are not solely considering the relative claims to priority of himself and his friend, but the interests of science generally

episode.outcome: The sketch records that Wallace's paper was read alongside Darwin's on 1 July 1858. It then follows his later career, his reservation about natural selection and human origins, his honours and works, and closes with the 1876 book on the geographical distribution of animals.
episode.quote: was read before that body on July 1, 1858, coincidently with the reading of Mr, Darwin's paper

quote.quote: provided Mr. Darwin did not withhold from the public, as he was strongly inclined to do (in favour of Mr. Wallace), the memoir which he had himself written on the same subject

claims.sentence: 同样，证据包没有说明华莱士在宣读之前是否知情、是否同意，这一点本文不作任何陈述。
claims.scope: W2-LINN全文与W2-PSM全文。达尔文'提议'征得华莱士同意，但信中没有说同意是否已取得，也没有说华莱士知道宣读一事。不过信中有莱尔和胡克的说法：两位作者都已'unreservedly'把论文交到他们手里。

quote.quote: both authors having now unreservedly placed their papers in our hands

claims.fix: 改'证据包'为'两份材料'。并补一句：信中达尔文只是提议征得华莱士同意，结果未载；莱尔和胡克则称两位作者都已'毫无保留地'把论文交给他们。这是安排者的说法，不等于华莱士知道宣读一事。

claims.sentence: Likewise, the evidence does not say whether Wallace knew of the reading beforehand or consented to it, and this article makes no statement either way.
claims.scope: Full W2-LINN and W2-PSM. Darwin 'proposed' to obtain Wallace's consent, but the outcome is not stated. The letter does assert that both authors had 'unreservedly placed their papers in our hands'.

quote.quote: both authors having now unreservedly placed their papers in our hands

claims.fix: Say 'neither source states...', and add that the letter asserts both authors had unreservedly placed their papers with Lyell and Hooker. That is the arrangers' claim, not a record of Wallace's knowledge of the reading.

claims.sentence: The price is that it leaves no record of who did what.

context_issues.problem: 小传给出的达尔文论文标题与1858年会刊所印标题不同，稿件直接转述小传标题而未说明这一出入。

quote.quote: On the Tendency of Species to form Varieties; and on the Perpetuation of Varieties and Species by Natural Means of Selection.

context_issues.problem: 小传说华莱士论文'transmitted through Sir Charles Lyell'。按1858年信，论文是先寄给达尔文、再由达尔文转交的，且由莱尔与胡克两人联名提交，宜点明小传的简化。

quote.quote: This was written at Ternate in February 1858, for the perusal of his friend and correspondent Mr. Darwin, and sent to him with the expressed wish that it should be forwarded to Sir Charles Lyell

context_issues.problem: 说'证据未说明华莱士是否同意'时，漏掉了信中安排者的说法：两位作者都已把论文毫无保留地交给他们。读者需要知道这一说法存在，同时知道它只是安排者的单方陈述。

quote.quote: both authors having now unreservedly placed their papers in our hands

review.overall: 稿件对两份来源的结局（达尔文同意、1858年7月1日同场宣读）叙述准确。各条'未载'断言在全文范围内成立，但谈华莱士是否同意时，宜补上信中'unreservedly placed their papers in our hands'这一安排者说法，并注明小传的标题与转交路径和1858年记录有出入。
